title: thelypteris longifolia f. glandulosa
intro: Thelypteris longifolia f. glandulosa, commonly known as the glandular maiden fern, is a plant species in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is a type of fern that has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Thelypteris longifolia f. glandulosa include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of this plant include antioxidant and anti-hemorrhagic effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and phenolic acids.
